title: 535. Implement Rand10() Using Rand7()

examples.explanation: Any single value from 1 to 10 is acceptable; the judge only checks the range.
Return one independent uniform draw per requested call.

hints: Two rand7 draws combine into 49 equally likely pairs; map them to the numbers 1-40 and retry on 41-49.
Each accepted value `r` in 1..40 converts with `(r - 1) % 10 + 1`.
